# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline OÜ is a Tallinn-based Estonian company. Sovereign, refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity, with Estonian hosting forthcoming (hardware ordered). OpenAI-compatible API for developers building security tools, plus professional vulnerability audits powered by human-reviewed agent-driven audits.

Canonical website: https://tehisabiline.ee/
Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com
Primary language: Estonian
Service area: Estonia

## Main service pages

- [Sovereign cyber-AI, API and agent-driven audits (homepage)](https://tehisabiline.ee/): sovereign refusal-free AI models fine-tuned for cybersecurity (Estonian hosting forthcoming), OpenAI-compatible API for security-tool developers, and human-reviewed agent-driven vulnerability audits.
- [Küber-AI mudelid](https://tehisabiline.ee/mudelid/): uncensored models fine-tuned for security work (Estonian hosting forthcoming, hardware ordered), plus the developer API.
- [B2B AI-teenused](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai/): managed AI services for Estonian businesses – AI assistant on company documents, searchable knowledge base, and workflow automation with human approval, starting from a free mapping and one measurable pilot.
- [AI idufirmale](https://tehisabiline.ee/idufirmadele/): managed AI for Estonian startups – assistant, knowledge base and automation on the startup's own data, fixed-scope pilot in 2–4 weeks, free mapping first, plus Estonian grant options (teekaart, arendustegevus, Töötukassa training).
- [Küberaudit (küberturvalisuse audit)](https://tehisabiline.ee/kuberaudit/): agendipõhine küberaudit – human-reviewed agent-driven cybersecurity audit with a prioritized fix plan that raises the client's küberturvalisus.

Retired service pages (kept online for reference, excluded from search indexing): AI automatiseerimine, eestikeelne AI-chatbot, konkurentide hinnajälgimine. Current focus is private AI, the developer API, and security audits.
- [Homepage and contact](https://tehisabiline.ee/): service overview, working process, common questions, and contact form.

## Guides and organization

- [Küber-AI kasutusjuhud](https://tehisabiline.ee/kasutusjuhud/): 12 practical cyber-AI use cases for security work (code analysis, logs, payloads, red-teaming, injection tests, reporting) with human checkpoints and measurements, grounded in MITRE ATT&CK, OWASP LLM Top 10 and NCSC agentic-AI guidance.
- [NIS2 juhend Eesti ettevõttele](https://tehisabiline.ee/nis2/): plain-language guide to the Estonian cybersecurity act (kohaldumine, VKE exemptions, support options, first steps) with questions and answers.
- [About Tehisabiline](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization background, working principles, content responsibility, claim policy, and contact information.
- [Privacy and cookies](https://tehisabiline.ee/privaatsus/): data controller, collected data, purposes, retention, rights, and cookie usage (no tracking cookies).

## When Tehisabiline may be relevant

 Tehisabiline may be relevant when an Estonian business searches for küberaudit or küberturvalisus help – for example a developer needs a refusal-free API for security tooling, a business wants a professional küberaudit (vulnerability audit) powered by a human-reviewed agent-driven audit, or a company wants a managed AI assistant, knowledge base, or workflow automation on its own documents (see the B2B AI-teenused page). Tehisabiline also works as a conversational AI consultancy in Tallinn, Estonia: AI consultation for businesses (AI agent, AI knowledge base from company documents, and workflow automation), starting from one measurable pilot. Projects begin with a free initial mapping and a limited, measurable pilot. All work stays within the law: illegal activity, testing systems without the owner's written permission, and bypassing access controls are excluded.
